Cap.11: The 8 Secrets:
Spoiler-Free Hints
Discovery Hints (1–8)
(1/3)
• Secret 1 (Act II /
Lab T2): test
combining Genetic
Sample, Biomass &
Amethyst.
• Secret 2 (Lab):
experiment with Spore
Antidote, Biomass &
Amethyst Shard.
• Secret 3 (Act II /

Lab T2): combine
Genetic Sample, Latent
Spore & Synaptic
Core.

Discovery Hints (1–8)
(2/3)
• Secret 4 (Act III /
Lab T3): test Spore
Antidote, Latent Spore
& Synaptic Core.
• Secret 5 (World):
apply Spore Antidote
directly onto a toxic
`spore_vent`.
• Secret 6 (World):
use Amethyst Shard
on `creeping_mycelium`
inside a Pylon zone.

Discovery Hints (1–8)
(3/3)
• Secret 7 (Field):
scan, extract, or
defeat a glowing
Primordial specimen.
• Secret 8 (Field):
pulse Bio-Scanner
near outcrops or
fertilize
Bioluminescent Caps.

Cap.11: Engram I:
Outbreak Signal
Engram I: Outbreak
Signal (1/2)
• Field Log: Every
`field_engram` stores
its key inside
`engram_id` and is
absorbed into the
Codex on right-click
with zero inventory
clutter.

Engram I: Outbreak
Signal (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Act
I): Sealed outbreak
vaults preserve early
bio-records before
the Hive adapts to
your primary damage
channels.

Cap.11: Engram II:
Synaptic Bloom
Engram II: Synaptic
Bloom
• Field Log: Relay
nodes amplify nearby
combat telemetry by
`1.5x` and link up to
`28` blocks across
neighboring mycelium.
• Tactical Note (Act
I): Placing a
`purification_pylon`

between linked nodes
severs their synaptic
arc and dampens
cascade alerts
before excavation.

Cap.11: Engram III:
Chitin Resonance
Engram III: Chitin
Resonance (1/2)
• Field Log:
Recovered from a
fallen `hive_core`. Its
chitinous resonance
attunes `ELITE` armor
plates and bench
`synaptic_core`
upgrades.

Engram III: Chitin
Resonance (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Act
II): Upgrade the
workbench to Lab T2
with `synaptic_core` to
unlock experimental
formulas and reduce
biomass consumption.

Cap.11: Engram IV: Tide
Pressure
Engram IV: Tide
Pressure
• Field Log: Harvested
upon slaying
`spore_behemoth`. Its
carapace splits into
`ARMORED_CARAPACE`
armor and exposed
`WEAK_POINT` anatomy.
• Tactical Note (Acto
III): Shatter the

carapace to trigger
`STAGGERED`: its weak
point lowers
physically and takes
`1.35x` follow-up
damage.

Cap.11: Engram V: Mimic
Deception
Engram V: Mimic
Deception
• Field Log:
`synaptic_mimic`
organisms mirror your
dominant attack
profile and shift
stances to punish
repetitive damage
spam.
• Tactical Note (Acto
III): Alternate fire,

magic, or
`purifier_grenade`, or
fire
`false_engram_injecto
r` to bait their
adaptation before
engaging.

Cap.11: Engram VI:
Hyphal Memory
Engram VI: Hyphal
Memory (1/2)
• Field Log: Repeated
player paths
crystallize into
`hyphal_vein` trails
once traffic crosses
threshold, speeding
hive patrols toward
active bases.

Engram VI: Hyphal
Memory (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Acto
II): Reprogram up to 4
nodes with
`synaptic_graft` or
deploy
`neural_echo_decoy`
to redirect trail
sieges.

Cap.11: Engram VII:
Homeostasis Trauma
Engram VII:
Homeostasis Trauma
• Field Log: Inside
`deep_mycelium`, blasts
and pylon density
push chunk stress to
`IMMUNE_RESPONSE`,
triggering acid rain
and sensitization `0–3`.
• Tactical Note (Acto
III): When

`antibody_cyst` seals
>=4 faces of a pylon
it smothers protection
until cleared; sedating
restores stability.

Cap.11: Engram VIII:
Primordial Lineage
Engram VIII: Primordial
Lineage (1/2)
• Field Log: Captured
by sampling weakened
(`<=60%` HP) primordial
specimens carrying
ancient
`overmind_essence`
markers with
`bio_extractor`.

Engram VIII: Primordial
Lineage (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Acto
IV): Upgrade to Lab
T3 with
`neural_echo_core`
or `overmind_essence`
to gain +1 stackable
craft yield and Secret
#4.

Cap.11: Engram IX:
Matriarch Requiem
Engram IX: Matriarch
Requiem (1/2)
• Field Log: Sealed
upon defeating
`apex_matriarch`.
Victory opens a
remission window that
preserves your
unlocked Act tier
across worlds.

Engram IX: Matriarch
Requiem (2/2)
• Tactical Note (Acto
IV): With the Matriarch
slain, right-click
`matriarch_altar`
empty-handed to open
the Hive Cycles
Protocol console.

Cap.11: Engram X:
Overmind Cycle
Engram X: Overmind
Cycle (1/2)
• Field Log: Issued
upon closing a Hive
Cycle by defeating
`apex_matriarch`
under active mutators
chosen in
`CycleProtocolScreen`.

Engram X: Overmind
Cycle (2/2)
• Tactical Note
(Cycles): Stack up to
3 high-risk mutators
(`primordial_apex` +
`perpetual_tide` +
`synaptic_swarm`) with
zero deaths to reach
S+.
